documents.title: TEC Register 2026-04-19 — 18 new applications, 4 terminations
documents.extract: Weekly TEC snapshot shows 18 new applications totalling 3.2 GW, concentrated in ScotP and East Anglia. Four terminations free 612 MW at Cottam [1]. No material change to current AR7 eligibility queue [2].
documents.body: Weekly TEC snapshot shows 18 new applications totalling 3.2 GW, concentrated in Scottish transmission (ScotP) and East Anglia. Four terminations free 612 MW at Cottam. The top new application is a 900MW offshore wind CO-connection at Creyke Beck. TEC register queue volume 441GW, of which 287 projects (84GW) have progressed through Gate 2 PAW1. No material change to AR7 eligibility queue composition.

documents.title: AR7 budget notice published — £1.5bn solar pot confirmed at £65/MWh
documents.extract: DESNZ AR7 budget notice confirms £1.5bn for Pot 1 (established technologies, solar only) with administrative strike price of £65/MWh (2012 prices) [1]. Delivery year 2029/30 [2].
documents.body: DESNZ AR7 budget notice confirms £1.5bn for Pot 1 (established technologies, solar only). Administrative strike price set at £65/MWh in 2012 prices, equivalent to approximately £91/MWh in 2026 money. Delivery year 2029/30. Solar eligibility requires Gate 2 connection milestone evidence. Budget is a 40% uplift vs AR6 Pot 1 and reflects DESNZ determination to accelerate 2030 Clean Power Mission.

documents.title: Little Crow Solar Park extension — DCO application accepted for examination
documents.extract: PINS has accepted the Little Crow extension DCO for examination. Capacity 480 MW, 1,800 acres, North Lincolnshire [1]. s55 decision confirmed April 17 [2]. Preliminary meeting expected July 2026.
documents.body: PINS has accepted the Little Crow Solar Park extension DCO for examination. Scheme adds 480 MW solar and 200 MWh BESS across 1,800 acres in North Lincolnshire, connecting at West Burton 400kV. s55 decision confirmed April 17 with standard conditions on BNG and cumulative impact assessment. Preliminary meeting expected July 2026, examination to complete by March 2027.

documents.title: South Oxfordshire DC — 210MW data centre + 180MW BESS co-located approved
documents.extract: Validated application for 210MW hyperscale DC with co-located 180MW/360MWh BESS on 28ha near Didcot [1]. Grid connection secured at Didcot A 400kV via private wire [2].
documents.body: South Oxfordshire District Council approved a 210MW hyperscale data centre with co-located 180MW/360MWh BESS on 28 hectares near Didcot. Grid connection secured at Didcot A 400kV via private wire. Conditions include heat export study, BNG 10% and scheduled substation commissioning by Q4 2028. Operator disclosed as hyperscale tenant via SPV Didcot Digital Holdings Ltd.

documents.title: UKPN ECR — 42 new 11kV entries across East region
documents.extract: UK Power Networks embedded capacity register update — 42 new entries, mostly rooftop solar 500kW-3MW [1]. Two notable BESS entries at 9MW and 12MW in Essex [2].
documents.body: UK Power Networks embedded capacity register update — 42 new entries, mostly rooftop solar 500kW-3MW. Two notable BESS entries at 9MW and 12MW in Essex. Total capacity in delta 118MW. ECR headroom at Bramford 132kV down to 22MW, triggering automatic queue-close review.

documents.title: NGED ECR — 450MW BESS accepted at Walham 400kV
documents.extract: National Grid Electricity Distribution confirmed capacity offer for 450MW/900MWh BESS at Walham. Energisation date 2029 Q2 [1]. No reinforcement required [2].
documents.body: National Grid Electricity Distribution confirmed capacity offer for 450MW/900MWh BESS at Walham 400kV to Zenobe Energy. Energisation date 2029 Q2. No reinforcement required; system impact study clears on 2-hour duration constraint. Adds to GB BESS pipeline now 67GW in planning and 34GW with secured connection.

documents.title: TEC Register delta — Hinkley Point C generation slot reserved
documents.extract: 3,260MW TEC slot confirmed for Hinkley Point C with energisation window 2029-2031 [1]. No impact on connection queue for renewables at SW transmission [2].
documents.body: 3,260MW TEC slot confirmed for Hinkley Point C with energisation window 2029-2031. No impact on connection queue for renewables at SW transmission; parallel reinforcement at Melksham and Bridgwater allocated in RIIO-T3.

documents.title: Gate Burton Energy Park — examination concluded
documents.extract: Examining Authority closed the Gate Burton (500MW solar + BESS) examination [1]. Secretary of State decision due within 3 months [2].
documents.body: Examining Authority closed the Gate Burton (500MW solar + 200MW BESS) examination. Secretary of State decision due within 3 months per PA2008 s107. Developer Low Carbon has forward-committed panel supply and is prepping financial close in H2 2026.

documents.title: West Berkshire — 99MW solar farm at Sheepdrove validated
documents.extract: West Berkshire Council validated 99MW solar on 210ha [1]. BNG plan promises +12% uplift via species-rich margins [2]. Objections from CPRE lodged.
documents.body: West Berkshire Council validated a 99MW solar application at Sheepdrove on 210ha. BNG plan targets +12% net gain via species-rich margins. Objections from CPRE and local parish councils on landscape grounds. Committee date October 2026.

documents.title: Thurrock — 300MW BESS submitted adjacent to Tilbury
documents.extract: Major BESS application 300MW/600MWh submitted to Thurrock Council [1]. Planning Statement cites HSE 2026 siting guidance compliance [2].
documents.body: Major BESS application 300MW/600MWh submitted to Thurrock Council adjacent to Tilbury docks. Planning Statement cites HSE 2026 siting guidance compliance including 15m separation distances and COMAH notification. Adds to 67GW UK BESS pipeline.

documents.title: SSEN — Beauly-Denny line rebuild creates 1.2GW headroom
documents.extract: SSEN Transmission reinforcement on the B6 boundary releases 1.2GW headroom for onshore wind and solar in ScotP [1]. Forecast energisation Q4 2028 [2].
documents.body: SSEN Transmission reinforcement on the B6 Scotland-England boundary releases 1.2GW headroom for onshore wind and solar in ScotP. Forecast energisation Q4 2028. Addresses long-standing constraint-driven curtailment (ScotP curtailment 2025 totalled 3.8TWh).

documents.title: AR7 Pot 2 budget — offshore wind £200m indicated
documents.extract: DESNZ indicated Pot 2 budget of £200m for fixed-bottom offshore wind in AR7 [1]. Pot 3 floating wind to be announced separately [2].
documents.body: DESNZ indicated Pot 2 budget of £200m for fixed-bottom offshore wind in AR7. Administrative strike price £73/MWh in 2012 prices. Pot 3 floating wind to be announced separately. Industry response mixed — RenewableUK calls budget insufficient for 2030 delivery.

documents.title: RIIO-ED3 Sector Specific Methodology consultation opens
documents.extract: Ofgem opened ED3 SSMC (2028-2033 price control). Responses due 30 June 2026 [1]. Key focus: flexibility-first, DSO obligations, digitalisation [2].
documents.body: Ofgem opened the RIIO-ED3 Sector Specific Methodology Consultation for the 2028-2033 distribution price control. Responses due 30 June 2026. Key focus areas: flexibility-first network planning, DSO obligations, digitalisation standards, connection reform incentives.

documents.title: T-1 Capacity Auction 2026/27 — clearing price £24.50/kW
documents.extract: T-1 auction cleared at £24.50/kW/yr, procuring 7.8GW [1]. BESS awarded 2.1GW (de-rated) across 112 CMUs [2].
documents.body: T-1 auction for delivery year 2026/27 cleared at £24.50/kW/yr, procuring 7.8GW net derated capacity. BESS awarded 2.1GW (de-rated) across 112 CMUs. T-4 for 2029/30 scheduled for February 2026 with revised de-rating factors published.

documents.title: EN-3 revised — solar >50MW NSIP threshold retained
documents.extract: DESNZ confirmed EN-3 revisions retain 50MW NSIP threshold for solar [1]. New presumption in favour of co-located BESS + solar [2].
documents.body: DESNZ confirmed EN-3 revisions retain 50MW NSIP threshold for solar and designated a new presumption in favour of co-located BESS with solar (§2.10.55). Threshold review for onshore wind deferred to 2027.

documents.title: Gate 2 Project Assessment Window 1 — 287 projects progressed (84GW)
documents.extract: NESO published PAW1 outcomes: 287 projects (84GW) progressed to connections agreement stage [1]. 412 projects declined or paused [2].
documents.body: NESO published Gate 2 Project Assessment Window 1 outcomes. 287 projects (84GW) progressed to connections agreement stage. 412 projects declined or paused. Average queue reduction for Gate 2 eligible projects 32 months vs pre-reform baseline. PAW2 opens July 2026.

documents.title: BNG on NSIPs — statutory guidance effective 26 May 2026
documents.extract: Statutory BNG requirement (10% net gain) applies to NSIP DCO applications accepted on or after 26 May 2026 [1]. Grace period for live examinations clarified [2].
documents.body: Statutory BNG (10% net gain) applies to NSIP DCO applications accepted on or after 26 May 2026 per Environment Act 2021 Sch 14A. Grace period for live examinations confirms applications already in s55 are not in scope. Statutory credit prices published by Natural England at £42,000-£650,000/unit depending on habitat type.

documents.title: Slough — 120MW data centre expansion at Bath Road campus approved
documents.extract: Slough BC approved an expansion of existing hyperscale campus adding 120MW IT load [1]. Grid connection upgraded via SSEN 132kV spur agreed Q4 2025 [2].
documents.body: Slough Borough Council approved a 120MW IT-load expansion of the Bath Road hyperscale campus. Grid connection via SSEN 132kV spur agreed Q4 2025. Conditions include heat network connection feasibility, on-site BESS for load-following, and transport plan. Operator undisclosed but widely reported to be Equinix expansion.

documents.title: DC/DM/DR monthly settlement — BESS revenue £24/MW/h March
documents.extract: Dynamic Containment low cleared £9/MW/h average in March [1]. Dynamic Moderation £6/MW/h, Dynamic Regulation £9/MW/h [2]. Total stack £24/MW/h equivalent.
documents.body: NESO published March 2026 settlement for Dynamic Containment, Dynamic Moderation, Dynamic Regulation services. DC Low cleared £9/MW/h average, DM £6/MW/h, DR £9/MW/h. Total theoretical stacked revenue £24/MW/h, though realised due to co-optimisation and balancing mechanism typically 60-70% of stack.

documents.title: CfD reference price update — baseload £78.20/MWh Q1
documents.extract: Baseload reference price for CfD settlement Q1 2026 set at £78.20/MWh [1]. Intermittent reference price £72.40/MWh for solar/wind [2].
documents.body: LCCC published CfD reference prices Q1 2026: baseload £78.20/MWh, intermittent £72.40/MWh for solar/wind. Strike-minus-reference difference payments will therefore be smaller than FY2025 for most CfD generators. RO generators unaffected.

documents.title: Pexapark PPA index — UK solar 10yr baseload £58/MWh
documents.extract: Pexapark quarterly update puts UK 10-year baseload solar PPA at £58/MWh [1]. Pay-as-produced structures trading at £53/MWh with £5 capture risk haircut [2].
documents.body: Pexapark Q1 2026 UK PPA tracker: 10-year baseload solar PPA £58/MWh (+2% QoQ). Pay-as-produced at £53/MWh reflects £5 capture risk haircut. CPPA volumes up 18% YoY with hyperscaler demand dominant.

documents.title: Northern Powergrid — £1.2bn ED3 draft business plan
documents.extract: NPg consultation sets out £1.2bn ED3 (2028-2033) capex including 28 substation rebuilds and 240km underground reinforcement [1][2].
documents.body: Northern Powergrid draft ED3 business plan proposes £1.2bn capex 2028-2033 including 28 substation rebuilds, 240km underground reinforcement, and 7 strategic 132kV bays for BESS/solar connection hubs in Teesside and East Riding.

documents.title: Scottish Government — Energy Strategy refresh, onshore wind 20GW by 2030
documents.extract: Scottish Energy Strategy refresh targets 20GW onshore wind and 5GW solar by 2030 [1]. NPF4 interpretation prioritises B6 boundary reinforcement projects [2].
documents.body: Scottish Government refreshed Energy Strategy targets 20GW onshore wind and 5GW solar by 2030. NPF4 Policy 11 interpretation note prioritises projects reinforcing B6 boundary. Five-year review signalled for 2029.

documents.title: HSE BESS fire safety — enhanced separation distances
documents.extract: HSE updated separation distances to 15m for containers >2MWh when adjacent to occupied structures [1]. COMAH threshold reviewed for LFP cells [2].
documents.body: HSE updated BESS safety guidance: 15m separation for containers >2MWh adjacent to occupied structures, up from 10m. COMAH Competent Authority note reviews Lower Tier threshold for LFP chemistries; current position 200 tonnes unchanged but under review after two 2025 fire incidents at Hampshire and East Yorkshire sites.

documents.title: Ormond Energy Ltd — 3 new SPVs registered (Lincs/Essex/Kent)
documents.extract: Ormond Energy registered three new SPVs with SIC 35110 in the last 48 hours [1]. Directors overlap with recent 150MW Lincolnshire solar DCO [2].
documents.body: Ormond Energy registered three new SPVs with SIC 35110 (electric power generation) in Lincolnshire, Essex, and Kent over the last 48 hours. Director overlap with the 150MW Lincolnshire solar DCO previously filed by the group suggests a co-located BESS pipeline.

documents.title: SIF Alpha — £8m award for transmission DLR rollout
documents.extract: SIF Alpha round awarded £8m to a consortium led by NGET for dynamic line rating at scale [1][2].
documents.body: SIF Alpha round awarded £8m to a consortium led by NGET for dynamic line rating (DLR) at scale across four OHL corridors. Expected 8-12% uplift in thermal capacity during high-wind conditions. Project runs 2026-2028.

documents.title: Mallard Pass Solar — redetermination DCO submitted
documents.extract: Mallard Pass redetermination DCO (350MW) submitted following High Court remittal [1]. Preliminary meeting scheduled August 2026 [2].
documents.body: Mallard Pass redetermination DCO (350MW) submitted following High Court remittal. PINS acceptance expected May 2026, preliminary meeting August 2026. Scheme location straddles Lincolnshire/Rutland border with Ryhall 132kV connection.

documents.title: ENW — 78MW data centre load accepted at Trafford Park
documents.extract: Electricity North West confirmed capacity for 78MW data centre load at Trafford Park Primary [1]. No reinforcement, energisation Q1 2028 [2].
documents.body: Electricity North West confirmed capacity for a 78MW data centre load at Trafford Park Primary substation. No reinforcement required, energisation Q1 2028. Adds to Manchester DC cluster (cumulative ENW DC load now 240MW in ECR).

documents.title: TEC register — Triton Knoll OFW termination frees 857MW
documents.extract: Termination of Triton Knoll extension MSA returns 857MW of TEC to the queue [1]. Expected to be reallocated via Gate 2 PAW2 [2].
documents.body: Termination of Triton Knoll extension MSA returns 857MW of TEC to the queue. Expected to be reallocated via Gate 2 PAW2 (July 2026 window). RWE cites revised economics post-AR6 clearing price.

documents.title: Cornwall — 45MW solar + 30MW BESS at Goss Moor withdrawn
documents.extract: Application withdrawn following officer recommendation of refusal on landscape grounds [1]. Applicant indicates re-submission with revised layout [2].
documents.body: Application withdrawn following officer recommendation of refusal on landscape grounds at Goss Moor SAC buffer. Statkraft indicates re-submission Q3 2026 with revised layout reducing panel area by 18%.

documents.title: West London — 240MW data centre approved at Hayes (Hillingdon)
documents.extract: Hillingdon Council approved 240MW hyperscale DC at Hayes [1]. SSEN offered 132kV connection with 2029 energisation [2]. BNG 12% via off-site credits.
documents.body: Hillingdon Council resolved to approve a 240MW hyperscale data centre at Hayes (West London). SSEN offered 132kV connection with 2029 energisation. BNG 12% via off-site credits. Conditions include noise attenuation, heat export feasibility study, and S106 for transport improvements. Scheme is first major DC approval in West London DC constraint zone since NESO declared 2GW constrained.

documents.title: Scotland — Google confirms 180MW data centre at Dundee
documents.extract: Dundee City Council approved Google's 180MW data centre campus with onshore-wind CPPA [1]. Energisation 2029 via SSEN Tealing 275kV [2].
documents.body: Dundee City Council approved Google's 180MW data centre campus. Accompanied by 15-year CPPA for Scottish onshore wind. Energisation 2029 via SSEN Tealing 275kV. Google announcement cites £500m investment over 3 years and 350 operational roles.

documents.title: Manchester — 160MW AWS data campus planning committee approves
documents.extract: Manchester City Council planning committee approved AWS's 160MW data campus at Wythenshawe [1]. ENW accepted capacity at Trafford Park with no reinforcement [2].
documents.body: Manchester City Council planning committee approved AWS's 160MW data campus at Wythenshawe by 9-2. ENW accepted capacity at Trafford Park Primary with no reinforcement required. AWS commits to 100% renewable matching via CPPA portfolio. Construction 2026-2028.

documents.title: West London Data Centre NSIP — DCO accepted for 600MW campus
documents.extract: PINS accepted a West London NSIP DCO application for a 600MW data centre campus [1]. Applicant is a hyperscaler consortium; s55 checklist cleared [2].
documents.body: PINS accepted a West London NSIP DCO application for a 600MW data centre campus spanning 45ha across Hillingdon/Ealing boundary. Applicant is a hyperscaler consortium. s55 checklist cleared. Scheme relies on direct 400kV connection at Iver substation with £120m reinforcement package. Examination opens August 2026.

documents.title: Hampshire — Microsoft 140MW data centre approval at Basingstoke
documents.extract: Basingstoke & Deane approved Microsoft's 140MW DC campus [1]. SSEN 132kV connection at Lovedean substation with 2028 energisation [2].
documents.body: Basingstoke & Deane Borough Council approved Microsoft's 140MW DC campus on a former industrial site. SSEN 132kV connection at Lovedean substation. Energisation 2028. Microsoft confirms Azure region capacity expansion. Conditions include on-site solar rooftop of 4MW and BESS for load following.

documents.title: Leeds — 110MW data centre submitted at Temple Green
documents.extract: Leeds City Council received application for a 110MW DC at Temple Green [1]. NGED capacity offer at Osbaldwick 132kV pending system study [2].
documents.body: Leeds City Council received a 110MW data centre application at Temple Green. NGED capacity offer at Osbaldwick 132kV pending system study. Committee date June 2026. Operator remains undisclosed but SPV directors overlap with CyrusOne affiliates.

documents.title: Cambridge cluster — 90MW Meta data centre planning submitted
documents.extract: South Cambridgeshire received Meta's 90MW DC planning submission at Waterbeach [1]. Connection via UKPN Burwell 132kV agreed Q4 2025 [2].
documents.body: South Cambridgeshire DC received Meta's 90MW data centre planning submission at Waterbeach. Connection via UKPN Burwell 132kV agreed Q4 2025 with minor reinforcement. Scheme supports Cambridge AI research cluster expansion. Committee September 2026.

documents.title: Docklands — 75MW Oracle data centre approval at Silvertown
documents.extract: Newham Council approved Oracle's 75MW data centre at Silvertown [1]. UKPN 132kV connection at West Ham energisation 2028 [2].
documents.body: Newham Council approved Oracle's 75MW data centre at Silvertown. UKPN 132kV connection at West Ham with 2028 energisation. Conditions include OCGT back-up phase-out by 2032 and hydrogen-ready generator specification. Oracle confirms UK Cloud Region capacity expansion.

documents.title: REMA decision — reformed national pricing retained, no locational split
documents.extract: DESNZ confirmed reformed national pricing as the long-term wholesale design [1]. Locational pricing / nodal not pursued; constraint costs addressed via Strategic Planner + connections reform [2].
documents.body: DESNZ published the REMA Phase 2 decision: reformed national pricing retained as the long-term GB wholesale market design. Locational / nodal pricing not pursued. Constraint management addressed via the Strategic Spatial Energy Plan, Gate 2 connections reform, and enhanced balancing mechanism transparency. Capacity Market reform to follow in 2027.

documents.title: East Yorkshire — 180MW BESS approved at Creyke Beck
documents.extract: East Riding approved 180MW/720MWh BESS adjacent to Creyke Beck [1]. 4-hour duration targets evening peak arbitrage [2].
documents.body: East Riding of Yorkshire Council approved a 180MW/720MWh BESS adjacent to Creyke Beck 400kV substation. 4-hour duration targets evening peak arbitrage and ancillary stacking. Developer Fidra Energy targets 2028 commissioning.

documents.title: Wiltshire — 200MW BESS submitted at Melksham
documents.extract: Wiltshire Council received 200MW/800MWh BESS application at Melksham [1]. 4-hour duration, NGET 400kV connection Q1 2029 [2].
documents.body: Wiltshire Council received 200MW/800MWh BESS application at Melksham substation. 4-hour duration. NGET 400kV connection targeted Q1 2029. Developer Gresham House Energy Storage Fund.

documents.title: Rutland — 75MW solar approved at Oakham
documents.extract: Rutland Council approved 75MW solar at Oakham [1]. 180ha site, connection at Tinwell 33kV [2].
documents.body: Rutland Council approved a 75MW solar farm at Oakham on 180ha. Grid connection at Tinwell 33kV with energisation 2028. BNG plan +15% via species-rich grassland under panels. Developer Renewable Connections.

documents.title: Sunnica Energy Farm — extension DCO accepted
documents.extract: PINS accepted Sunnica extension DCO (+300MW solar, 200MW BESS) [1]. Scheme straddles Cambs/Suffolk border [2].
documents.body: PINS accepted Sunnica extension DCO adding 300MW solar and 200MW BESS to the consented 500MW scheme. Straddles Cambs/Suffolk border. Connection at Burwell 132kV with additional 400kV tap under study. Examination opens September 2026.

documents.title: Bramford BESS — 2GW NSIP DCO accepted
documents.extract: PINS accepted Bramford BESS DCO — the first 2GW BESS NSIP to reach acceptance [1]. Co-located solar 200MW [2].
documents.body: PINS accepted the Bramford BESS DCO, the first 2GW BESS NSIP to reach s55 acceptance. Co-located 200MW solar. Site adjacent to Bramford 400kV in Suffolk. Scheme tests DESNZ EN-1 BESS-as-NSIP categorisation. Examination opens October 2026.

documents.title: Norfolk — 45MW solar appeal allowed at Attleborough
documents.extract: Inspector allowed Lightsource BP appeal for 45MW solar at Attleborough [1]. Landscape harm outweighed by climate benefit [2].
documents.body: Planning Inspector allowed Lightsource BP appeal for 45MW solar at Attleborough. Decision cites landscape harm outweighed by climate benefit per EN-3 2026 designation. Appeal cost award to applicant partial.

documents.title: Kent — 60MW BESS appeal refused at Cliffe
documents.extract: Inspector refused 60MW BESS appeal at Cliffe on flood risk and fire safety grounds [1][2].
documents.body: Planning Inspector refused a 60MW BESS appeal at Cliffe on flood risk (Flood Zone 3) and HSE BESS fire safety siting grounds. Decision notes HSE 2026 separation distances not met from residential receptors (9m provided, 15m required).

documents.title: HSE BESS incident — East Yorkshire 50MW site thermal runaway
documents.extract: 50MW BESS fire contained within 14 hours at East Yorkshire site [1]. No injuries; root cause under investigation [2].
documents.body: 50MW BESS fire contained within 14 hours at an East Yorkshire site. No injuries. Containers isolated and thermal runaway limited to 2 units. Root cause under investigation; initial indication points to BMS firmware fault. First reportable UK BESS incident of 2026.

documents.title: HSE BESS incident — Hampshire 30MW site fire
documents.extract: 30MW BESS container fire at Hampshire site [1]. COMAH review triggered for LFP threshold [2].
documents.body: 30MW BESS container fire at a Hampshire site. Contained in 9 hours. Prompted COMAH Competent Authority review of LFP Lower Tier threshold. Minor offsite smoke plume; no evacuation.

documents.title: T-4 Capacity Auction 2029/30 — clearing price £65/kW
documents.extract: T-4 auction cleared at £65/kW/yr, procuring 43.6GW [1]. BESS awarded 4.8GW (de-rated) across 320 CMUs [2].
documents.body: T-4 auction for 2029/30 cleared at £65/kW/yr, procuring 43.6GW net derated capacity. BESS awarded 4.8GW (de-rated) across 320 CMUs, record volume. OCGT new-build awards 2.1GW. De-rating factors for 2hr BESS 11%, 4hr 36%.

documents.title: CMP395 — Final Modification Report published on constraint payments
documents.extract: Final Modification Report for CMP395 recommends capping constraint payment uplifts at LOLP proxy [1]. Decision expected Q3 2026 [2].
documents.body: Final Modification Report for CMP395 recommends capping constraint payment uplifts for BM units at a LOLP-proxy reference price to reduce consumer cost. Decision expected Q3 2026. Industry split on merits — storage providers argue cap hurts flex revenue stack.

documents.title: Amazon signs 650MW UK CPPA portfolio with Statkraft
documents.extract: Amazon signed a 650MW CPPA portfolio with Statkraft covering 8 UK onshore wind and solar projects [1][2].
documents.body: Amazon signed a 650MW UK CPPA portfolio with Statkraft covering 8 onshore wind and solar projects across Scotland and Yorkshire. 12-year pay-as-produced structure. Supports Amazon's UK net-zero data centre goal. Estimated £55/MWh blended price.

documents.title: Microsoft signs 420MW CPPA with SSE Renewables
documents.extract: Microsoft signed a 420MW offshore wind CPPA with SSE Renewables from Seagreen 2 [1][2].
documents.body: Microsoft signed a 420MW offshore wind CPPA with SSE Renewables from Seagreen 2. 15-year baseload structure. Supports Microsoft's UK AI datacentre growth. Estimated £68/MWh.

documents.title: SPEN — West Midlands ECR update, 340MW new connections accepted
documents.extract: SP Energy Networks accepted 340MW new connections across West Midlands in April [1]. ECR headroom at Berkswell 132kV down to 45MW [2].
documents.body: SP Energy Networks accepted 340MW of new connection offers across West Midlands in the April ECR window. Headroom at Berkswell 132kV down to 45MW from 210MW in January. Queue management now active at 14 primaries.

documents.title: SSEN — Southern region ECR, 420MW headroom at West London
documents.extract: SSEN ECR update flags just 420MW remaining headroom at West London GSP cluster [1]. Accelerated queue close expected Q3 2026 [2].
documents.body: SSEN Southern ECR update flags 420MW remaining headroom at West London GSP cluster (Iver, Laleham, Willesden). Accelerated queue close expected Q3 2026. DNO capex plan in ED3 adds 600MW capability by 2030 via Iver 400kV rebuild.

documents.title: NGED — Wales / West ECR, 88MW solar accepted
documents.extract: NGED accepted 88MW of solar connections across Wales and West England [1][2].
documents.body: NGED accepted 88MW of solar connections across Wales and West England in April. Largest single connection 36MW at Rassau 33kV. Capacity offers now waiting on Cardiff East 132kV reinforcement (2028).

documents.title: Low Carbon — £340m charge filing against Gate Burton project
documents.extract: Low Carbon filed £340m senior debt charge against Gate Burton Energy Park SPV [1][2].
documents.body: Low Carbon filed a £340m senior debt charge against the Gate Burton Energy Park SPV. Charge holders include ING, NatWest, and Santander. Signals imminent financial close ahead of DCO decision.

documents.title: Octopus Energy Generation — 12 new SPVs for 2026 Q2 pipeline
documents.extract: Octopus Energy Generation incorporated 12 new SPVs in March and April [1]. Directors suggest a BESS-focused pipeline in NGED region [2].
documents.body: Octopus Energy Generation incorporated 12 new SPVs in March and April 2026. Directors and SIC codes suggest a BESS-focused pipeline in NGED region. Cumulative OEG UK pipeline now 2.8GW across solar, onshore wind, BESS.

documents.title: Curtailment volumes — Q1 2026 constraint costs £520m
documents.extract: NESO Q1 2026 constraint costs £520m, ScotP contributed £340m driven by B6 congestion [1][2].
documents.body: NESO published Q1 2026 constraint cost breakdown: total £520m, of which ScotP onshore and offshore wind curtailment £340m driven by B6 boundary congestion. Constraint costs up 28% YoY. Solution: SSEN reinforcement (doc-011) + Strategic Spatial Energy Plan.

documents.title: TM04+ — connection methodology update, offer validity 18 months
documents.extract: NESO updated TM04+ methodology — capacity offer validity extended to 18 months [1][2].
documents.body: NESO updated TM04+ connection methodology to extend capacity offer validity from 12 to 18 months. Change reduces developer attrition post-offer. Applies to all Gate 2 progressed projects from 1 May 2026.

documents.title: RIIO-T3 Final Determination — £40bn transmission allowance
documents.extract: Ofgem published RIIO-T3 Final Determination — £40bn transmission allowance 2026-2031 [1][2].
documents.body: Ofgem published RIIO-T3 Final Determination for NGET, SSEN-T, SPT: £40bn transmission allowance 2026-2031. Accelerated Strategic Transmission Investment framework progresses 17 major projects totalling £22bn. TOs to submit first RIIO-T3 cost reports by December 2026.

documents.title: GB BESS pipeline — 67GW planning, 34GW secured connection
documents.extract: NESO modelled GB BESS pipeline — 67GW in planning, 34GW with secured connection offer [1][2].
documents.body: NESO modelled the GB BESS pipeline: 67GW in planning (DCO + LPA), 34GW with secured connection offer. Gate 2 PAW1 confirmed 12GW of BESS through to connections agreement. 2030 deployment forecast 27-34GW under central and tightened scenarios.

documents.title: Hornsea 5 — offshore wind DCO accepted, 2.5GW
documents.extract: PINS accepted Ørsted's Hornsea 5 DCO — 2.5GW offshore wind [1][2].
documents.body: PINS accepted Ørsted's Hornsea 5 DCO application — 2.5GW offshore wind off the Yorkshire coast. Grid connection at Creyke Beck 400kV and new substation at Salt End. Examination opens November 2026. Targets AR8 CfD in 2027.

documents.title: Scout Moor II onshore wind — DCO granted, 100MW
documents.extract: Secretary of State granted Scout Moor II onshore wind DCO (100MW) — first onshore wind DCO granted since 2016 lift [1][2].
documents.body: Secretary of State granted Scout Moor II onshore wind DCO — 100MW, 30 turbines across the South Pennines. First onshore wind DCO granted in England since the July 2024 de-facto ban lift. ENW connection at Whitegate Primary. Construction 2027-2029.
